text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been some time since I became Air
Shakur's trainer. We haven't
had any
glaring issues, but I do have one concern.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Talk, huh... What about?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us haven't gotten any closer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even on a good day, Air Shakur's attitude
towards me is prickly at
best. But I want to
do everything I can to support her in the
Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And for me to do that, she needs to trust
me. Obviously it won't
happen all at once,
but surely I can build up that trust little by
little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After asking around, I managed to come
up with a few ideas to help
us get closer.
All that's left is to bring them up to Air
Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? An outdoor festival? No way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What? You made your own PC? You? Huh... And?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's becoming clear that Air Shakur doesn't
want to interact with me
outside
training-related business.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So now you want to spend the day
together, huh? What's gotten into
you
recently?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not necessary. We only formed a contract
because I needed a trainer
for my debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We don't even have to talk. All I can hope
is that this time together
will help her trust
me just a little more. Once I explain my
intentions
to her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We don't even have to talk. All I can hope
is that this time together
will help her trust
me just a little more. Once I explain my
intentions
to her...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: All right, fine. Guess I'll just waste a day with this then... You said I could pick the place, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I meet up with Air Shakur the next
day. She then takes me
to...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One with only single booths at that. Our
booths aren't even next to
each other...
But I did promise she could pick, and I
won't go back on
my word.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I also don't know when our next outing
will be, if ever... So I have
to make this
work!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What now? This better be good, or I'm
kicking you out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm not hungry, nor do I think I will
be.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Would you SHUT UP?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All right, if you really wanna be friends or
whatever, give me. Some
damn. SPACE!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, miss, could we speak for a
moment?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
WHAT NOW?!
...Ah.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. Guess I can't go back there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Lots of trainers have business-like
arrangements with their trainees.
And it's
not like their race results suffer from that
lack of a personal
relationship.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you're aware of that fact too. So I
can think of only one
reason you'd keep
up this stupidity.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You must believe that us being all
buddy-buddy would be good for
me.
Seeing the loner avoid making friends
makes you sad, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Should've known better. Nothing
changes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The only partner I need is my PC. So quit
inviting me out. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur doesn't see the need to build
relationships with people. I
understand
that. After all, she made it this far on her
own, with only
her numbers to guide her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What will happen when she encounters a problem she can't solve on her own? I want to prepare for that possibility.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As always, you make no sense. Wouldn't it
be easier to just do as I
say?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Do whatever you want.
